description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Fuel Filler Inlet for the gas tank
Includes All Metal Locking Gas Cap
Fits fuel injected and carbureted models
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Gas Cap
Qty 1 – Fuel Filler Inlet
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
